description: Post one public reply under an Instagram comment, from the account that got the comment. Everyone can see it and it cannot be taken back, so show the user the words first. Take comment_id from sprkly_get_inbox_thread. If the answer says Instagram did not confirm, do not send it again: tell the user to check the post. Needs inbox access.

comment_id.description: The comment to answer, from sprkly_get_inbox_thread.
